name: Rokkasho (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Rokkasho village emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom beneath a crown-like device.
history: Municipal flag of Rokkasho, a village in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 9 February 1966.

features.role: Rokkasho village emblem — a ring open at the bottom beneath a crown-like device
